newsitem.title: USA: American States holders to meet on merger.
newsitem.headline: American States holders to meet on merger.

text.p: American States Financial Corp said Tuesday that its directors have called a special shareholders' meeting to vote on the company's proposed merger into SAFECO Corp.
The special meeting will be September 17 at the company's offices in Indianapolis. Shareholders of record August 8 are entitled to vote at the meeting.
The property-casualty insurer and Seattle-based SAFECO jointly announced June 9 a pact for SAFECO to acquire all American States stock, including an 83 percent stake owned by Lincoln National Corp.
The companies expect the deal to be completed in late September or early October.
